She said that as the gelding has a tendency to overrace, she chose not to ride the horse along to make up ground which resulted in the horse settling at the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced through the early stages. Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event. When questioned, rider stated that his mount began laying in from the 200m and felt awkward in its action, therefore he desisted in riding his mount out for the remainder of the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have a slow recovery and to have lost a the off-fore racing plate. Trainer advised the gelding would now be spelled.
